verses.original: וִיהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ זָקֵ֔ן בָּ֖א בַּיָּמִ֑ים וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלָ֗יו אַתָּ֤ה זָקַ֙נְתָּה֙ בָּ֣אתָ בַיָּמִ֔ים וְהָאָ֛רֶץ נִשְׁאֲרָ֥ה הַרְבֵּֽה־ מְאֹ֖ד לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wî·hō·wō·šu·a‘ zā·qên bā bay·yā·mîm way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lāw ’at·tāh zā·qan·tāh bā·ṯā ḇay·yā·mîm wə·hā·’ā·reṣ niš·’ă·rāh har·bêh- mə·’ōḏ lə·riš·tāh
verses.literal: Now Joshua was old and well along in years and the LORD said to him You are old and well along in years but very much of the land remains to be possessed
verses.literalPt: Estando Josué já velho e mui avançado em anos, disse-lhe Jeová: Tu estás já velho e de muita idade, e ainda fica muitíssima terra para se possuir.

verses.original: זֹ֥את הָאָ֖רֶץ הַנִּשְׁאָ֑רֶת כָּל־ גְּלִיל֥וֹת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וְכָל־ הַגְּשׁוּרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ hā·’ā·reṣ han·niš·’ā·reṯ kāl- gə·lî·lō·wṯ hap·pə·liš·tîm wə·ḵāl hag·gə·šū·rî
verses.literal: This is the land that remains All the territory of the Philistines . . . and the Geshurites
verses.literalPt: Esta é a terra que ainda fica: todas as regiões dos filisteus, e todos os gesuritas

verses.original: מִֽן־ הַשִּׁיח֞וֹר אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י מִצְרַ֗יִם וְעַ֨ד גְּב֤וּל עֶקְרוֹן֙ צָפ֔וֹנָה לַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֖י תֵּחָשֵׁ֑ב חֲמֵ֣שֶׁת׀ סַרְנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים הָעַזָּתִ֤י וְהָאַשְׁדּוֹדִי֙ הָאֶשְׁקְלוֹנִ֣י הַגִּתִּ֔י וְהָעֶקְרוֹנִ֖י וְהָעַוִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: min- haš·šî·ḥō·wr ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê miṣ·ra·yim wə·‘aḏ gə·ḇūl ‘eq·rō·wn ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh lak·kə·na·‘ă·nî tê·ḥā·šêḇ ḥă·mê·šeṯ sar·nê p̄ə·liš·tîm hā·‘az·zā·ṯî wə·hā·’aš·dō·w·ḏî hā·’eš·qə·lō·w·nî hag·git·tî wə·hā·‘eq·rō·w·nî wə·hā·‘aw·wîm
verses.literal: from the Shihor east . . . of Egypt to the territory of Ekron on the north (considered to be Canaanite territory) that of the five Philistine rulers of Gaza Ashdod Ashkelon Gath and Ekron as well as that of the Avvites
verses.literalPt: desde Sior, que está defronte do Egito, até o termo de Ecrom, para o Norte, a qual é tida como pertencente aos cananeus; os cinco régulos dos filisteus, os gazitas, os asdoditas, os ascalonitas, os gititas e os ecronitas; também os avins,

verses.original: מִתֵּימָ֞ן כָּל־ אֶ֣רֶץ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֗י וּמְעָרָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לַצִּידֹנִ֖ים עַד־ אֲפֵ֑קָה עַ֖ד גְּב֥וּל הָאֱמֹרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: mit·tê·mān kāl- ’e·reṣ hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî ū·mə·‘ā·rāh ’ă·šer laṣ·ṣî·ḏō·nîm ‘aḏ- ’ă·p̄ê·qāh ‘aḏ gə·ḇūl hā·’ĕ·mō·rî
verses.literal: to the south all the land of the Canaanites from Mearah of the Sidonians to Aphek as far as the border of the Amorites
verses.literalPt: no Sul, toda a terra dos cananeus, e Meara, que pertence aos sidônios, até Afeca, ao termo dos amorreus;

verses.original: וְהָאָ֣רֶץ הַגִּבְלִ֗י וְכָל־ הַלְּבָנוֹן֙ מִזְרַ֣ח הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ מִבַּ֣עַל גָּ֔ד תַּ֖חַת הַר־ חֶרְמ֑וֹן עַ֖ד לְב֥וֹא חֲמָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’ā·reṣ hag·giḇ·lî wə·ḵāl hal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn miz·raḥ haš·še·meš mib·ba·‘al gāḏ ta·ḥaṯ har- ḥer·mō·wn ‘aḏ lə·ḇō·w ḥă·māṯ
verses.literal: the land of the Gebalites and all Lebanon to the east . . . from Baal-gad below Mount Hermon to Lebo-hamath
verses.literalPt: a terra dos gebalitas e todo o Líbano, para o nascente do sol, desde Baal-Gade, ao pé do monte Hermom, até a entrada de Hamate;

verses.original: כָּל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָ֠הָר מִֽן־ הַלְּבָנ֞וֹן עַד־ מִשְׂרְפֹ֥ת מַ֙יִם֙ כָּל־ צִ֣ידֹנִ֔ים אָֽנֹכִי֙ אוֹרִישֵׁ֔ם מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רַ֠ק הַפִּלֶ֤הָ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּֽנַחֲלָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוִּיתִֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- yō·šə·ḇê hā·hār min- hal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn ‘aḏ- miś·rə·p̄ōṯ ma·yim kāl- ṣî·ḏō·nîm ’ā·nō·ḵî ’ō·w·rî·šêm mip·pə·nê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl raq hap·pi·le·hā lə·yiś·rā·’êl bə·na·ḥă·lāh ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯî·ḵā
verses.literal: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth-maim all the Sidonians I Myself will drive out before the Israelites . . . Be sure to divide it by lot as an inheritance to Israel as I have commanded you
verses.literalPt: todos os habitantes da região montanhosa, desde Líbano até Misrefote-Maim, a saber, todos os sidônios; eu os desapossarei de diante dos filhos de Israel; reparte, pois, a terra por herança a Israel, como te ordenei.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה חַלֵּ֞ק אֶת־ הָאָ֧רֶץ הַזֹּ֛את בְּנַחֲלָ֖ה לְתִשְׁעַ֣ת הַשְּׁבָטִ֑ים וַחֲצִ֖י הַשֵּׁ֥בֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ḥal·lêq ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ bə·na·ḥă·lāh lə·ṯiš·‘aṯ haš·šə·ḇā·ṭîm wa·ḥă·ṣî haš·šê·ḇeṭ ham·naš·šeh
verses.literal: Now therefore divide this land as an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe . . . of Manasseh
verses.literalPt: Agora, divide tu esta terra por herança entre as nove tribos e a meia tribo de Manassés.

verses.original: עִמּ֗וֹ הָרֽאוּבֵנִי֙ וְהַגָּדִ֔י לָקְח֖וּ נַחֲלָתָ֑ם אֲשֶׁר֩ נָתַ֨ן לָהֶ֜ם מֹשֶׁ֗ה בְּעֵ֤בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ מִזְרָ֔חָה כַּאֲשֶׁר֙ נָתַ֣ן לָהֶ֔ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה עֶ֥בֶד יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘im·mōw hā·r·’ū·ḇê·nî wə·hag·gā·ḏî lā·qə·ḥū na·ḥă·lā·ṯām ’ă·šer nā·ṯan lā·hem mō·šeh bə·‘ê·ḇer hay·yar·dên miz·rā·ḥāh ka·’ă·šer nā·ṯan lā·hem mō·šeh ‘e·ḇeḏ Yah·weh
verses.literal: The other half of Manasseh along with the Reubenites and Gadites had received the inheritance Moses had given them beyond the Jordan to the east just as Moses the servant of the LORD had assigned to them
verses.literalPt: Com essa tribo, os rubenitas e os gaditas já receberam a sua herança, além do Jordão, para o oriente, assim como Moisés, servo de Jeová, lhes deu;

verses.original: מֵעֲרוֹעֵ֡ר אֲשֶׁר֩ עַל־ שְׂפַת־ נַ֨חַל אַרְנ֜וֹן וְהָעִ֨יר אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּתוֹךְ־ הַנַּ֛חַל וְכָל־ הַמִּישֹׁ֥ר מֵידְבָ֖א עַד־ דִּיבֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: mê·‘ă·rō·w·‘êr ’ă·šer ‘al- śə·p̄aṯ- na·ḥal ’ar·nō·wn wə·hā·‘îr ’ă·šer bə·ṯō·wḵ- han·na·ḥal wə·ḵāl ham·mî·šōr mê·ḏə·ḇā ‘aḏ- dî·ḇō·wn
verses.literal: The area from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley along with the city in the middle of the valley the whole plateau of Medeba as far as Dibon
verses.literalPt: desde Aroer, que está à beira do vale da torrente de Arnom, e a cidade que está no meio do vale, e todo o planalto de Medeba até Dibom;

verses.original: וְכֹ֗ל עָרֵי֙ סִיחוֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָלַ֖ךְ בְּחֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן עַד־ גְּב֖וּל בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl ‘ā·rê sî·ḥō·wn me·leḵ hā·’ĕ·mō·rî ’ă·šer mā·laḵ bə·ḥeš·bō·wn ‘aḏ- gə·ḇūl bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn
verses.literal: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites who reigned in Heshbon as far as the border of the Ammonites . . .
verses.literalPt: todas as cidades de Seom, rei dos amorreus, que dominava em Hesbom, até o termo dos filhos de Amom;

verses.original: וְהַגִּלְעָ֞ד וּגְב֧וּל הַגְּשׁוּרִ֣י וְהַמַּעֲכָתִ֗י וְכֹ֨ל הַ֥ר חֶרְמ֛וֹן וְכָל־ הַבָּשָׁ֖ן עַד־ סַלְכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hag·gil·‘āḏ ū·ḡə·ḇūl hag·gə·šū·rî wə·ham·ma·‘ă·ḵā·ṯî wə·ḵōl har ḥer·mō·wn wə·ḵāl hab·bā·šān ‘aḏ- sal·ḵāh
verses.literal: also Gilead and the territory of the Geshurites and Maacathites all of Mount Hermon and all Bashan as far as Salecah
verses.literalPt: Gileade, e o território dos gesuritas e dos maacatitas, e todo o monte Hermom, e todo o Basã, até Salcá;

verses.original: כָּל־ מַמְלְכ֥וּת עוֹג֙ בַּבָּשָׁ֔ן אֲשֶׁר־ מָלַ֥ךְ בְּעַשְׁתָּר֖וֹת וּבְאֶדְרֶ֑עִי ה֤וּא נִשְׁאַר֙ מִיֶּ֣תֶר הָרְפָאִ֔ים וַיַּכֵּ֥ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה וַיֹּרִשֵֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- mam·lə·ḵūṯ ‘ō·wḡ bab·bā·šān ’ă·šer- mā·laḵ bə·‘aš·tā·rō·wṯ ū·ḇə·’eḏ·re·‘î hū niš·’ar mî·ye·ṯer hā·rə·p̄ā·’îm way·yak·kêm mō·šeh way·yō·ri·šêm
verses.literal: the whole kingdom of Og in Bashan who had reigned in Ashtaroth and Edrei and had remained as a remnant of the Rephaim Moses had struck them down and dispossessed them
verses.literalPt: todo o reino de Ogue em Basã, o qual reinou em Astarote e em Edrei (Ele era dos refains que ficaram.). Moisés os feriu e desapossou.

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א הוֹרִ֙ישׁוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־ הַגְּשׁוּרִ֖י וְאֶת־ הַמַּעֲכָתִ֑י וַיֵּ֨שֶׁב גְּשׁ֤וּר וּמַֽעֲכָת֙ בְּקֶ֣רֶב יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō hō·w·rî·šū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- hag·gə·šū·rî wə·’eṯ- ham·ma·‘ă·ḵā·ṯî way·yê·šeḇ gə·šūr ū·ma·‘ă·ḵāṯ bə·qe·reḇ yiś·rā·’êl ‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: but the Israelites . . . did not drive out the Geshurites or the Maacathites So Geshur and Maacath dwell among the Israelites to this day
verses.literalPt: Contudo, os filhos de Israel não expulsaram aos gesuritas nem aos maacatitas, mas Gesur e Maacate ficaram habitando no meio de Israel até o dia de hoje.

verses.original: רַ֚ק לְשֵׁ֣בֶט הַלֵּוִ֔י לֹ֥א נָתַ֖ן נַחֲלָ֑ה אִשֵּׁ֨י יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ ה֣וּא נַחֲלָת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּר־ לֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: raq lə·šê·ḇeṭ hal·lê·wî lō nā·ṯan na·ḥă·lāh ’iš·šê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl hū na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw ka·’ă·šer dib·ber- lōw
verses.literal: To the tribe of Levi however Moses had given no inheritance The food offerings to the LORD the God of Israel are their inheritance just as He had promised them
verses.literalPt: Tão somente à tribo de Levi não deu herança; as ofertas queimadas, de Jeová, Deus de Israel, são a sua herança, como lhe falou.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֔ה לְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ רְאוּבֵ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên mō·šeh lə·maṭ·ṭêh ḇə·nê- rə·’ū·ḇên lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām
verses.literal: This is what Moses had given to the clans of the tribe of Reuben
verses.literalPt: Moisés deu herança à tribo dos filhos de Rúben, segundo as suas famílias.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֨י לָהֶ֜ם הַגְּב֗וּל מֵעֲרוֹעֵ֡ר אֲשֶׁר֩ עַל־ שְׂפַת־ נַ֨חַל אַרְנ֜וֹן וְהָעִ֨יר אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּתוֹךְ־ הַנַּ֛חַל וְכָל־ הַמִּישֹׁ֖ר עַל־ מֵידְבָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî lā·hem hag·gə·ḇūl mê·‘ă·rō·w·‘êr ’ă·šer ‘al- śə·p̄aṯ- na·ḥal ’ar·nō·wn wə·hā·‘îr ’ă·šer bə·ṯō·wḵ- han·na·ḥal wə·ḵāl ham·mî·šōr ‘al- mê·ḏə·ḇā
verses.literal: The territory from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley along with the city in the middle of the valley to the whole plateau beyond Medeba
verses.literalPt: Foi o seu território desde Aroer, que está à beira do vale da torrente de Arnom, e a cidade que está no meio do vale, e todo o planalto junto a Medeba;

verses.original: חֶשְׁבּ֥וֹן וְכָל־ עָרֶ֖יהָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּמִּישֹׁ֑ר דִּיבוֹן֙ וּבָמ֣וֹת בַּ֔עַל וּבֵ֖ית בַּ֥עַל מְעֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ḥeš·bō·wn wə·ḵāl ‘ā·re·hā ’ă·šer bam·mî·šōr dî·ḇō·wn ū·ḇā·mō·wṯ ba·‘al ū·ḇêṯ ba·‘al mə·‘ō·wn
verses.literal: to Heshbon and all its cities on the plateau including Dibon Bamoth-baal Beth-baal-meon
verses.literalPt: Hesbom e todas as suas cidades que estão no planalto: Dibom, Bamote-Baal e Bete-Baal-Meom,

verses.original: וְיַ֥הְצָה וּקְדֵמֹ֖ת וּמֵפָֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yah·ṣāh ū·qə·ḏê·mōṯ ū·mê·p̄ā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: Jahaz Kedemoth Mephaath
verses.literalPt: Jaza, Quedemote e Mefaate,

verses.original: וְקִרְיָתַ֣יִם וְשִׂבְמָ֔ה וְצֶ֥רֶת הַשַּׁ֖חַר בְּהַ֥ר הָעֵֽמֶק׃
verses.transliteration: wə·qir·yā·ṯa·yim wə·śiḇ·māh wə·ṣe·reṯ haš·ša·ḥar bə·har hā·‘ê·meq
verses.literal: Kiriathaim Sibmah Zereth-shahar on the hill in the valley
verses.literalPt: Quiriataim, Sibma e Zerete-Saar no monte do vale;

verses.original: וּבֵ֥ית פְּע֛וֹר וְאַשְׁדּ֥וֹת הַפִּסְגָּ֖ה וּבֵ֥ית הַיְשִׁמֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇêṯ pə·‘ō·wr wə·’aš·dō·wṯ hap·pis·gāh ū·ḇêṯ hay·ši·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: Beth-peor the slopes of Pisgah and Beth-jeshimoth
verses.literalPt: Bete-Peor, as faldas de Pisga e Bete-Jesimote,

verses.original: וְכֹל֙ עָרֵ֣י הַמִּישֹׁ֔ר וְכָֽל־ מַמְלְכ֗וּת סִיחוֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָלַ֖ךְ בְּחֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן אֲשֶׁר֩ הִכָּ֨ה מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֹת֣וֹ׀ וְאֶת־ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י מִדְיָ֗ן אֶת־ אֱוִ֤י וְאֶת־ רֶ֙קֶם֙ וְאֶת־ צ֤וּר וְאֶת־ חוּר֙ וְאֶת־ רֶ֔בַע נְסִיכֵ֣י סִיח֔וֹן יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl ‘ā·rê ham·mî·šōr wə·ḵāl mam·lə·ḵūṯ sî·ḥō·wn me·leḵ hā·’ĕ·mō·rî ’ă·šer mā·laḵ bə·ḥeš·bō·wn ’ă·šer hik·kāh mō·šeh ’ō·ṯōw wə·’eṯ- nə·śî·’ê miḏ·yān ’eṯ- ’ĕ·wî wə·’eṯ- re·qem wə·’eṯ- ṣūr wə·’eṯ- ḥūr wə·’eṯ- re·ḇa‘ nə·sî·ḵê sî·ḥō·wn yō·šə·ḇê hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: all the cities of the plateau and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites who reigned in Heshbon until Moses - killed him and the chiefs of Midian Evi Rekem Zur Hur and Reba the princes of Sihon who lived in the land
verses.literalPt: todas as cidades do planalto e todo o reino de Seom, rei dos amorreus, o qual reinou em Hesbom, a quem Moisés feriu juntamente com os príncipes de Midiã: Evi, Requém, Zur, Hur e Reba, príncipes de Seom, que moravam na terra.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ בִּלְעָ֥ם בֶּן־ בְּע֖וֹר הַקּוֹסֵ֑ם הָרְג֧וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בַּחֶ֖רֶב אֶל־ חַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- bil·‘ām ben- bə·‘ō·wr haq·qō·w·sêm hā·rə·ḡū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ba·ḥe·reḇ ’el- ḥal·lê·hem
verses.literal: The Israelites . . . also killed the diviner Balaam son of Beor along with the others they put to the sword . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Também os filhos de Israel mataram à espada o adivinho Balaão, filho de Beor, juntamente com os mais que foram mortos por eles.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י גְּבוּל֙ בְּנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֔ן הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן וּגְב֑וּל זֹ֣את נַחֲלַ֤ת בְּנֵֽי־ רְאוּבֵן֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔ם הֶעָרִ֖ים וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·hî gə·ḇūl bə·nê rə·’ū·ḇên hay·yar·dên ū·ḡə·ḇūl zōṯ na·ḥă·laṯ bə·nê- rə·’ū·ḇên lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām he·‘ā·rîm wə·ḥaṣ·rê·hen
verses.literal: And the border of the Reubenites . . . was the bank of the Jordan This was the inheritance of the clans of the Reubenites . . . including the cities and villages
verses.literalPt: Ficou sendo o termo dos filhos de Rúben o Jordão e as suas adjacências. Os filhos de Rúben, segundo as suas famílias, tiveram esta herança com as cidades e as suas aldeias.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן מֹשֶׁה֙ לְמַטֵּה־ גָ֔ד לִבְנֵי־ גָ֖ד לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên mō·šeh lə·maṭ·ṭêh- ḡāḏ liḇ·nê- ḡāḏ lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām
verses.literal: This is what Moses had given to the clans of the tribe of Gad . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Deu Moisés herança à tribo de Gade, aos filhos de Gade, segundo as suas famílias.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י לָהֶם֙ הַגְּב֔וּל יַעְזֵר֙ וְכָל־ עָרֵ֣י הַגִּלְעָ֔ד וַחֲצִ֕י אֶ֖רֶץ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן עַד־ עֲרוֹעֵ֕ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י רַבָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî lā·hem hag·gə·ḇūl ya‘·zêr wə·ḵāl ‘ā·rê hag·gil·‘āḏ wa·ḥă·ṣî ’e·reṣ bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn ‘aḏ- ‘ă·rō·w·‘êr ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê rab·bāh
verses.literal: The territory of Jazer all the cities of Gilead and half the land of the Ammonites . . . as far as Aroer near . . . Rabbah
verses.literalPt: Foi o seu território Jazer, e todas as cidades de Gileade, e a metade da terra dos filhos de Amom, até Aroer, que está defronte de Rabá;

verses.original: וּמֵחֶשְׁבּ֛וֹן עַד־ רָמַ֥ת הַמִּצְפֶּ֖ה וּבְטֹנִ֑ים וּמִֽמַּחֲנַ֖יִם עַד־ גְּב֥וּל לִדְבִֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mê·ḥeš·bō·wn ‘aḏ- rā·maṯ ham·miṣ·peh ū·ḇə·ṭō·nîm ū·mim·ma·ḥă·na·yim ‘aḏ- gə·ḇūl liḏ·ḇir
verses.literal: the territory from Heshbon to Ramath-mizpeh . . . and Betonim and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir
verses.literalPt: Desde Hesbom até Ramate-Mispa, e Betonim; desde Maanaim até o termo de Debir;

verses.original: וּבָעֵ֡מֶק בֵּ֣ית הָרָם֩ וּבֵ֨ית נִמְרָ֜ה וְסֻכּ֣וֹת וְצָפ֗וֹן יֶ֚תֶר מַמְלְכ֗וּת סִיחוֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֔וֹן הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן וּגְבֻ֑ל עַד־ קְצֵה֙ יָם־ כִּנֶּ֔רֶת עֵ֥בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן מִזְרָֽחָה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·‘ê·meq bêṯ hā·rām ū·ḇêṯ nim·rāh wə·suk·kō·wṯ wə·ṣā·p̄ō·wn ye·ṯer mam·lə·ḵūṯ sî·ḥō·wn me·leḵ ḥeš·bō·wn hay·yar·dên ū·ḡə·ḇul ‘aḏ- qə·ṣêh yām- kin·ne·reṯ ‘ê·ḇer hay·yar·dên miz·rā·ḥāh
verses.literal: and in the valley Beth-haram Beth-nimrah Succoth and Zaphon with the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon (the territory on the east side of the Jordan up to the edge of the Sea of Chinnereth
verses.literalPt: e, no vale, Bete-Arã, Bete-Nimra, Sucote e Zafom, resto do reino de Seom, rei de Hesbom, o Jordão e suas adjacências, até a extremidade do mar de Quinerete, além do Jordão, para o oriente.

verses.original: זֹ֛את נַחֲלַ֥ת בְּנֵי־ גָ֖ד לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם הֶעָרִ֖ים וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ na·ḥă·laṯ bə·nê- ḡāḏ lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām he·‘ā·rîm wə·ḥaṣ·rê·hem
verses.literal: This was the inheritance of the clans of the Gadites . . . including the cities and villages
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Gade, segundo as suas famílias, tiveram esta herança com as cidades e as suas aldeias.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֔ה לַחֲצִ֖י שֵׁ֣בֶט מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וַיְהִ֗י לַחֲצִ֛י מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên mō·šeh la·ḥă·ṣî šê·ḇeṭ mə·naš·šeh way·hî la·ḥă·ṣî maṭ·ṭêh ḇə·nê- mə·naš·šeh lə·miš·pə·ḥō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: This is what Moses had given to the clans of the half-tribe . . . of Manasseh that is to half the tribe of the descendants of Manasseh
verses.literalPt: À meia tribo de Manassés, deu Moisés a herança que era para a meia tribo dos filhos de Manassés segundo as suas famílias.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י גְבוּלָ֗ם מִמַּחֲנַ֨יִם כָּֽל־ הַבָּשָׁ֜ן כָּֽל־ מַמְלְכ֣וּת׀ ע֣וֹג מֶֽלֶךְ־ הַבָּשָׁ֗ן וְכָל־ חַוֺּ֥ת יָאִ֛יר אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּבָּשָׁ֖ן שִׁשִּׁ֥ים עִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḡə·ḇū·lām mim·ma·ḥă·na·yim kāl- hab·bā·šān kāl- mam·lə·ḵūṯ ‘ō·wḡ me·leḵ- hab·bā·šān wə·ḵāl ḥaw·wōṯ yā·’îr ’ă·šer bab·bā·šān šiš·šîm ‘îr
verses.literal: The territory from Mahanaim through all Bashan all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan including all the towns of Jair that are in Bashan sixty cities
verses.literalPt: Foi o seu território desde Maanaim, todo o Basã, todo o reino de Ogue, rei de Basã, e todas as aldeias de Jair, que estão em Basã, sessenta cidades.

verses.original: וַחֲצִ֤י הַגִּלְעָד֙ וְעַשְׁתָּר֣וֹת וְאֶדְרֶ֔עִי עָרֵ֛י מַמְלְכ֥וּת ע֖וֹג בַּבָּשָׁ֑ן לִבְנֵ֤י מָכִיר֙ בֶּן־ מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה לַחֲצִ֥י בְנֵֽי־ מָכִ֖יר לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wa·ḥă·ṣî hag·gil·‘āḏ wə·‘aš·tā·rō·wṯ wə·’eḏ·re·‘î ‘ā·rê mam·lə·ḵūṯ ‘ō·wḡ bab·bā·šān liḇ·nê mā·ḵîr ben- mə·naš·šeh la·ḥă·ṣî ḇə·nê- mā·ḵîr lə·miš·pə·ḥō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: half of Gilead and Ashtaroth and Edrei the royal cities of Og in Bashan All this was for the clans of the descendants of Machir son of Manasseh that is, half of the descendants of Machir
verses.literalPt: A metade de Gileade, Astarote e Edrei, cidades do reino de Ogue, em Basã, foram para os filhos de Maquir, filhos de Manassés, isto é, para a metade dos filhos de Maquir, segundo as suas famílias.

verses.original: אֵ֕לֶּה אֲשֶׁר־ נִחַ֥ל מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּעַֽרְב֣וֹת מוֹאָ֑ב מֵעֵ֛בֶר לְיַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרִיח֖וֹ מִזְרָֽחָה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh ’ă·šer- ni·ḥal mō·šeh bə·‘ar·ḇō·wṯ mō·w·’āḇ mê·‘ê·ḇer lə·yar·dên yə·rî·ḥōw miz·rā·ḥāh
verses.literal: These were the portions Moses had given them on the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan east of Jericho
verses.literalPt: Estas são as heranças que Moisés distribuiu nas planícies de Moabe, além do Jordão, na altura de Jericó, para o oriente.

verses.original: וּלְשֵׁ֙בֶט֙ הַלֵּוִ֔י לֹֽא־ נָתַ֥ן מֹשֶׁ֖ה נַחֲלָ֑ה יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ ה֣וּא נַחֲלָתָ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·šê·ḇeṭ hal·lê·wî lō- nā·ṯan mō·šeh na·ḥă·lāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl hū na·ḥă·lā·ṯām ka·’ă·šer dib·ber lā·hem
verses.literal: To the tribe of Levi however Moses had given no inheritance The LORD the God of Israel . . . is their inheritance just as He had promised them
verses.literalPt: Mas à tribo de Levi Moisés não deu herança; Jeová, Deus de Israel, é a sua herança, como lhes falou.
